summary: Brookfield Renewable Corp filed a Form 6-K on June 17, 2026, reporting results of its annual meeting of shareholders. All eight director nominees were elected with overwhelming support (each receiving over 91% votes for), and Ernst & Young LLP was reappointed as external auditor. The filing details voting mechanics: Exchangeable Shares (Class A) represent a 25% aggregate voting interest, while Class B Multiple Voting Shares hold 75% aggregate voting interest. There are no transaction-specific terms, deal structures, or special-situation events disclosed. This is a routine governance filing, not a special situation, and no advisor, premium, or timeline is stated. What to watch: no risk-arb angle exists as the filing is purely administrative.
